technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with momentum crossovers offset by overbought conditions, weak trend strength, and price below long-term moving averages—moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 29 days with elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling and absent news confirmation; market sentiment heavily bearish (53.5% bearish) suggests capitulation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (356.16) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 29 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Momentum crossovers (AO, Ichimoku TK) with 20-day new high and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) offer tactical entry near support (70.84) ahead of potential capitulation reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 200-EMA and 50-SMA with overbought oscillators, weak ADX (13.61), low volume conviction (0.78), zero fundamental support, imminent earnings binary risk, and macro crisis regime (VIX 356) create unfavorable risk/reward despite technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Momentum crossovers (AO, Ichimoku TK) with 20-day new high and extreme fear sentiment present tactical contrarian setup at support (70.84). However, macro crisis regime (VIX 356), overbought oscillators, price below 200-EMA, and imminent earnings (29 days) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Macro VIX crisis regime combined with earnings binary event in 29 days creates severe tail risk; overbought technicals and weak trend strength (ADX 13.61) suggest momentum may reverse sharply on any negative catalyst.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner (bear) reflects conflicting signals.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MU position with 50 existing IT sector positions (13.6% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation warrant minimal sizing if entry occurs; existing position should be reviewed for exit before new entry.
